name: dsh-voice-call
description: GPT/豆包式语音通话插件 for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI：麦克风说话 → 本地 sherpa-onnx 识别 → DeepSeek 流式回答 → edge-tts 语音播放，支持说话打断。Voice call for DSH: local STT + streaming LLM + edge-tts, with barge-in.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check scripts\wire-profile.mjs && node --check scripts\unwire-profile.mjs && python -m py_compile engine\server.py scripts\fetch_model.py

dsh.name: 语音通话
dsh.permissions: 麦克风采集(浏览器), 本地引擎子进程(sherpa-onnx/edge-tts), 调用已配置的 LLM provider(OpenAI 兼容接口)
